months.note: 3월 초순이면 서울 근교에 와 있고, 산란기는 4월 하순~5월이다.

summary: 우리나라에 오는 여름새 가운데 가장 먼저 도착하는 아종으로, 3월 초순이면 이미 서울 근교에 와 있다. 도시와 농촌의 지붕이나 옥상, 냇가와 하천, 농경지와 구릉 등 곳곳에서 흔히 눈에 띈다. 쌓인 바위 틈이나 건물 틈에 둥지를 틀고 4월 하순~5월에 알을 낳으며, 거미와 곤충을 주로 먹는다. 유라시아 대륙 전역에서 번식하고 남쪽의 온대·아열대·열대 지역에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: White Wagtail (Motacilla alba), adult male of the breeding subspecies leucopsis (Amur Wagtail) in breeding plumage, as seen at Korean riversides from March: forehead, face, ear-coverts, sides of the neck, chin and throat white, with no dark eye-stripe; crown, nape, mantle, back and rump black; a neat black breast patch below the white throat; belly and undertail coverts white; wing coverts largely white, forming a big white panel on the closed wing; flight feathers brownish-black edged white; tail black with white outer feathers. Thin black bill; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: walking on riverside gravel, side view
art.scene: Korean riverside in early spring with farmland and low hills beyond; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, breeding plumage (March–July), side view walking: white forehead and face with no eye-stripe, black from crown to rump, black breast patch below the white throat, large white wing panel, brownish-black flight feathers, long black tail with white edges, thin bill, black legs
adult male in fresh autumn plumage (September–October), front view standing: white forehead, face and throat, black breast with white feather fringes, black crown, thin black bill
art.build: Slender, long-tailed wagtail, about 21cm including the long tail, longer and much slimmer than a sparrow; walks briskly (does not hop) and pumps its tail up and down constantly. Rounded head, short neck, horizontal stance. Bill thin, straight, black, shorter than the head and noticeably fine. Legs fairly long and slender, black. Long tertials cover most of the closed primaries, and the tail extends far beyond the wingtips. Tail long, narrow and square-ended, black with white outer feathers. Flight deeply undulating.
avoid: Do not paint a black line through the eye; that belongs to other subspecies such as lugens and ocularis. The leucopsis male has a clean white face.
Do not paint a grey back on the adult male; it is black from crown to rump.
Do not paint a black chin or throat; the black starts below a white throat.
Do not paint any yellow on the underparts (Grey or Eastern Yellow Wagtail).
Do not shorten the tail or show the bird hopping.
